statusDefinitions.confirmed_free: Current source explicitly displayed Free/zero-cost under its marketplace terms.
statusDefinitions.cc0: CC0/public-domain style content; retain source record even when attribution is not required.
statusDefinitions.cc_by: Commercially usable Creative Commons Attribution content; attribution ledger required.
statusDefinitions.conditional_free: Zero-cost only while stated eligibility conditions remain satisfied; recheck at acquisition/use time.
statusDefinitions.open_source: Open-source software/tooling; comply with its software license and keep third-party notices as required.
statusDefinitions.watchlist: Quality candidate only; zero-cost commercial entitlement has not been proven. Do not acquire as paid content without a separate decision.

assets.name: MetaHuman
assets.use: Highest-ceiling survivor face/body generation route; export through DCC and build Unity Humanoid derivatives.
assets.mobileAction: Use card hair, simplified facial runtime, 2K-or-lower textures, Unity-specific LODs and URP materials.

assets.name: Survival Character FREE
assets.use: Primary male survivor standalone FBX audition.
assets.mobileAction: Humanoid import, material consolidation, LOD0/1/2, animation retargeting.

assets.name: Modern Female Character
assets.use: Realistic civilian female base character.
assets.mobileAction: Fit winter clothing, convert to Unity Humanoid, retain only resolvable skin/detail at shipping camera.

assets.name: Aria Blake - Game Ready
assets.use: Alternate realistic female body/face candidate.
assets.mobileAction: Unity package/FBX audition, simplify materials and textures, build LODs.

assets.name: Puffer Jacket A
assets.use: Civilian cold-weather outerwear donor.
assets.mobileAction: Fit/skin in Blender or DCC, rebake maps if needed, consolidate material slots.

assets.name: Puffer Jacket B
assets.use: Second civilian winter silhouette for survivor diversity.
assets.mobileAction: Fit/skin, optimize and recolor into Havenline palette.

assets.name: Medieval Gloves
assets.use: Realistic glove donor after visual de-fantasy pass.
assets.mobileAction: Fit/skin and downsample 4K source textures.

assets.name: Quixel Snow Material
assets.use: Primary physically based snow surface.
assets.mobileAction: Convert to Havenline URP packed maps; use 1K/2K runtime textures and blending masks.

assets.name: Photogrammetry Snow Material Pack
assets.use: Six compacted/soft/natural 4K snow material variants for terrain blending.
assets.mobileAction: Extract/convert source textures for Unity, atlas or blend only variants visible in gameplay.

assets.name: Quixel Snow Pile
assets.use: Large scan-quality snowbank/drift geometry to break flat terrain.
assets.mobileAction: Decimate/bake and author LODs; place only where silhouette matters.

assets.name: Quixel Rocky Snow Pile A
assets.use: Forest/perimeter snow-rock transition.
assets.mobileAction: Decimate, bake and LOD.

assets.name: Quixel Rocky Snow Pile B
assets.use: Alternate snow-rock silhouette to prevent repetition.
assets.mobileAction: Decimate, bake and LOD.

assets.name: Quixel Snow Clump
assets.use: Small accumulation around tents, logs, furnace, crates and barricades.
assets.mobileAction: Build several rotated/scaled variants from one optimized mesh/material.

assets.name: Quixel Pine Debris
assets.use: Pine needles/cones/bark breakup at forest edges and around trees.
assets.mobileAction: Use as decal/atlas material; avoid unique materials per placement.

assets.name: Alaskan Cliff Rock 1 Free
assets.use: Northern cliff/rock source for frozen forest boundary.
assets.mobileAction: Source is about one million vertices; mandatory decimation, normal bake and LODs.

assets.name: Alaskan Cliff Rock 3 Free
assets.use: Second northern cliff/rock silhouette.
assets.mobileAction: Mandatory decimation, bake and LODs.

assets.name: Free Rock Pile Scan
assets.use: Natural rock grouping / camp perimeter detail.
assets.mobileAction: Audit source license entitlement and optimize mesh before production.

assets.name: Poly Haven Pine Tree 01
assets.use: High-quality conifer source master.
assets.mobileAction: Never ship raw multi-million-triangle master; create LOD family and far impostor/billboard.

assets.name: Poly Haven Fir Tree 01
assets.use: Second conifer species to eliminate repeated toy-tree silhouettes.
assets.mobileAction: Create LOD family and shared foliage material/atlas.

assets.name: Poly Haven Barrel Stove
assets.use: Primary realistic furnace/heater replacement candidate.
assets.mobileAction: Downsample source textures, keep soot/burn PBR detail, author controlled internal flame and local light.

assets.name: Quixel Campfire
assets.use: Scanned burnt wood/stone/ash geometry for campfire base.
assets.mobileAction: Optimize geometry and pair with flipbook flame/smoke, not realtime fluid simulation.

assets.name: Forest Stones Campfire
assets.use: 120-photo photogrammetry fire-pit alternative with high-resolution source maps.
assets.mobileAction: Retopologize/decimate and bake source textures to mobile mesh.

assets.name: Log Pile Photogrammetry Scan
assets.use: Realistic resource pile and camp storytelling.
assets.mobileAction: Reduce 8K source and build runtime LODs.

assets.name: Free 4K Wood Log Scan
assets.use: Individual realistic log donor for carried resources and varied piles.
assets.mobileAction: Retopology/LOD and atlas with other logs where practical.

assets.name: Tents Model Free
assets.use: Shelter geometry base.
assets.mobileAction: Re-material with scanned tarp, add ropes/seams/entrance depth/snow contact; reject if silhouette stays low-poly.

assets.name: Quixel Weathered Tarp
assets.use: Photoreal shelter/canvas material replacement.
assets.mobileAction: Pack maps and use tiling/decals rather than unique 4K per tent.

assets.name: Camouflage Sleeping Bag
assets.use: Shelter interior/lived-in camp detail.
assets.mobileAction: Retexture away from camouflage if necessary; 1K source is already mobile-sensible.

assets.name: CC0 Axe
assets.use: Primary chopping/gathering axe.
assets.mobileAction: Downsample source maps; bind to hand via Animation Rigging constraint.

assets.name: Animated Wolf Scene
assets.use: Primary free animated wolf candidate.
assets.mobileAction: Retarget/clean animation states and LOD; attribution ledger required.

assets.name: Unity Labs Free VFX Image Sequences and Flipbooks
assets.use: Lightweight simulated fire/smoke/explosion image sequences.
assets.mobileAction: Build URP particle flipbooks; use campfire-scale variants and minimize overdraw.

assets.name: Brackeys VFX Bundle
assets.use: Additional free particle/flipbook source library.
assets.mobileAction: Select only restrained realistic-compatible elements; optimize particle counts/overdraw.

assets.name: Adobe Mixamo
assets.use: Base locomotion and interaction mocap library.
assets.mobileAction: Retarget/blend/foot-clean; raw clips are not final polish.

assets.name: Reallusion AccuRIG
assets.use: Humanoid rigging/re-rigging after body/clothing edits.
assets.mobileAction: Use to produce clean Unity Humanoid-compatible derivatives; source-asset licenses still govern art.

assets.name: Meshroom 2025.1 / AliceVision
assets.use: Revenue-independent photogrammetry pipeline for custom Havenline scan-quality assets.
assets.mobileAction: Reconstruct source masters only; retopologize/bake before Unity runtime import.

assets.name: RealityCapture
assets.use: High-productivity scan/reprojection alternative when current revenue eligibility is satisfied.
assets.mobileAction: Use for source reconstruction and high-to-low texture projection; recheck licensing at use time.

assets.name: UnityMeshSimplifier
assets.use: Automatable C# mesh simplification and LOD generation for scans/props.
assets.mobileAction: Audition offline/editor LOD generation on current Unity 6 project; latest release observed 3.1.1 in 2026.

assets.name: The Toby Foliage Engine / Light
assets.use: Current Unity 6 mobile-oriented foliage/wind shader audition.
assets.mobileAction: Test with optimized Pine/Fir LODs; profile alpha overdraw and batching on Android.

assets.name: URPFog
assets.use: Low-cost depth/distance/height fog baseline.
assets.mobileAction: Use cheap mode/noise-off baseline first; profile on device.

assets.name: Material Maker
assets.use: Free procedural PBR authoring/repacking for coherent Havenline materials.
assets.mobileAction: Export packed Unity-friendly maps and bake microdetail rather than adding shader complexity.

assets.name: Sonniss GameAudioGDC Bundles
assets.use: Professional winter wind, snow, cloth, fire, tools, impacts and wildlife audio source search.
assets.mobileAction: Select/trim/compress only required clips; retain bundle license record.
